description:
Precision is the difference between a clip and a film. With the RS 5’s enhanced motor torque and intelligent pan-tilt tracking, we’re capturing complex tracking shots that used to require a full crew.

DJI RS 5 features touchscreen subject selection with the new tracking module, smooth balancing from fine-tuning knobs, and direct control via the new briefcase handle —all backed by faster charging and extended battery life.

Gear used: DJI RS 5
